description: Generate docs/FINAL-BACKEND-REVIEW.md - a comprehensive backend review document with system verification, per-subsystem ratings, cross-repo gap analysis, prioritized import opportunities, and final verdict.
steps: Create docs/FINAL-BACKEND-REVIEW.md with the following sections:

1. SYSTEM VERIFICATION: Document test count (2,505 test functions across 101 files, ~39,203 lines of test code), source stats (54,136 lines across all src/nexus modules), 27 API route files, 42+ SQLModel tables, Docker Compose stack with PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7.

2. ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW: Document the lifespan handler (SQLite table creation, default company seeding, demo data seeding, governance state loading, config validation on startup, checkpoint persistence and shutdown logging), middleware stack (CORS, GovernanceMiddleware, APIVersionMiddleware, MetricsMiddleware, RequestIDMiddleware), 27 mounted routers from main.py.

3. PER-SUBSYSTEM RATINGS: Rate each of the 20+ subsystems (adapters, api, communication, company, evolution, governance, guardrails, identity, knowledge, meetings, memory, models, models_router, orchestration, runtime, services, templates, tools, triggers, workflows) on completeness (1-5), test coverage (1-5), production readiness (1-5) with brief justification for each.

4. CROSS-REPO GAP ANALYSIS: Compare NEXUS against 8 reference repos (MetaGPT, AI-company, PraisonAI, Clawith, paperclip, munder-difflin, NVLabsOrg, OpenCompany) and identify features present in those repos but NOT in NEXUS.

5. Gap analysis specifics to include: (a) MetaGPT: RAG engine with rankers/retrievers/parsers, experience pool with scorers/serializers, Tree-of-Thought strategy/solver, role-based agents (architect/PM/QA/researcher), provider diversity (Azure, Bedrock, Google, Spark, DashScope, Qianfan). (b) PraisonAI: streaming events system, snapshot/session persistence, agent profiling, Kanban board workflow, plugin SDK with builtin plugins, push notifications, LSP integration, model harness/eval framework, workspace adapters. (c) AI-company: MCP tool registry with toolset grouping and readonly mode, integration notifications (Slack/Discord-like), loop-based orchestration with graphs/nodes, ecosystem tools. (d) Clawith: realtime runtime (WebSocket streaming), document conversion service, sandbox service (local/remote), OKR management, channel-based chat with group handoff, session context compaction, scheduling lanes, product reconciler, workspace locking/collaboration. (e) paperclip: skills catalog/marketplace, plugin adapter system, teams catalog, realtime server, Google Sheets MCP, Tailscale HTTPS broker, evals framework. (f) munder-difflin: desktop process viewer (tmux-based), memory graph visualization, avatar-based agent representation. (g) NVLabsOrg: delegation router, prompt templates engine, worktree-based isolation, phase machine (shared concept), memory with L0 agent facts + shared knowledge + recovery context. (h) OpenCompany: CLI with daemon mode, deploy scripts, Terraform/GCP integration.

6. PRIORITIZED IMPORT OPPORTUNITIES: Rank the top 10-15 missing features by impact (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), effort (S/M/L/XL), and source repo. Focus on features that fill the biggest gaps in NEXUS's 'autonomous AI company' mission.

7. STRENGTHS SUMMARY: Document what NEXUS does exceptionally well compared to reference repos (comprehensive governance, 4-layer memory, evolution/AB testing, hive protocol, multi-adapter system, full compliance framework, etc.).
8. FINAL VERDICT: Overall maturity score (e.g., 8.5/10), key risks, recommended next priorities.
acceptance_criteria: docs/FINAL-BACKEND-REVIEW.md exists and is well-structured markdown
Document contains all 8 sections described in steps
Per-subsystem ratings table covers all 20+ subsystems with numeric scores
Cross-repo gap analysis references all 8 repos with specific missing features
Import opportunities are ranked with impact/effort/source columns
Final verdict includes a numeric maturity score and prioritized next steps
verification: Read docs/FINAL-BACKEND-REVIEW.md and confirm all sections are present and substantive
Confirm the document references actual file paths and module names from the NEXUS codebase
Confirm gap analysis references actual directories/features found in reference repos
findings: Document created with 488 lines covering all 7 major sections. All acceptance criteria verified: 20 subsystems rated, 8 repos analyzed with 67 specific gap entries, 15 import opportunities ranked, maturity score 8.4/10. Documentation-only change - no build/test needed.
